items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: Even Sonny Stitt came down there one time. He went over there and they had like a jam session over there with different ones.

ctx.x: So there wasn't a way that I could go in the day. And the day was better than the night. Even Sonny Stitt came down there one time. He went over there and they had like a jam session over there with different ones. And different ones sat in. That Paul Barbaran, what is his other brother? Had Paul Barbaran his brother?
